answer: The fable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the whisper. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
